title: Reduced One-Fluid GENERIC Closure from Relativistic Moment Kinetics
summary: In this work we derive a reduced one-fluid plasma model from the relativistic Vlasov--Boltzmann--Maxwell system using a moment hierarchy reduction combined with strong-guide-field anisotropic ordering. The unresolved higher-moment sector of the hierarchy is projected onto its dominant slow thermodynamic mode, producing a scalar regulator variable that represents a coarse-grained combination of charge imbalance, pressure anisotropy, and irreversible kinetic production channels.
